html:
Greetings, Agents.


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.


In this patch, you will encounter a young genius of prodigious intellect, 
the ancient God of War, and the leader of Olympus.

 

New Uniforms have been added for Hulk (Amadeus Cho), 
known as one of the most brilliant minds on Earth, 
and Ares, the warrior who has ceaselessly fought in wars for centuries.

 

Furthermore, Tier-4 Advancement has been added for Zeus, 
the supreme ruler of Olympus with divine authority, 
and Ares, the God of War proficient in various combat techniques.

 

Agents, please download the 11/18 (Tue) patch 
to check out their new skills and enhanced power!

 


■ 11/18 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 11/19 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 11/18 (Tue) 19:00 (PST)

 

[11/19 (Wed) 2:33 (UTC+0), 11/18 (Tue) 18:33 (PST) added]
The patch has been completed as of 11/19 (Wed) 2:31 (UTC+0), 11/18 (Tue) 18:31 (PST).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ Two New Uniforms


Two new Uniforms, Amadeus Cho <Heroic Age>, and Ares <Punisher> have been added.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The two new Uniforms will be on sale for 50% off during the <2025 Black Friday Discount & Bonus Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

▣ Zeus & Ares Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement is now available for Zeus, 
who has shown the majesty of a top-tier powerhouse with his near-infinite magical power, 
and Ares, the Incarnation of War whose endless thirst for battle leads the world into a battlefield.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 


▣ New Artifact

After the November patch, an Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Hulk (Amadeus Cho) and Ares will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes


1. The Tier-2 passive skill name for Zeus <Modern> has been changed.
- Zeus's Wrath → Wrath of Zeus

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The level-up materials for Native Tier-2 → Tier-3 growth heroes in Epic Quest 

have been adjusted to include Rank 1 Black Anti-matter/Phoenix Feathers.

 


We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
